record.name: Ophidia
record.appearance: olive-tan skin, amber slit-pupil eyes, a short black bob with a jade underlock, gold piercings, a glossy black cutout bodysuit, ivory armor, gold chains and rings, pointed gauntlets and heels, smoky cape panels and jade gel articulation; her colossal metamorph keeps the human upper torso attached to her own continuous armored serpent body, and her larvae share its jade gel, black flexible ribs, sparse ivory scales and gold neural nodes, huge soft living grubs with root and mycelial filaments beneath them

passive.name: blackwater nursery
passive.description: Start with two Brood pips. Moving 12 m (1200 cm) along the ground earns one pip, at most once every 6 s (180 ticks), reserve two. Hold a ground-targeted primary for 0.4 s (12 ticks) to spend one and lay a huge rooted gel larva at her feet. Maintain three larvae, each roughly 2.5 m (250 cm) long, with 15% of her maximum health and a 30 s (900 ticks) life. At capacity, deliberately select one to retire before laying another. They intercept hostile shots; bodies can be waded through slowly. Allies move through freely.
passive.notes: Root-transfer contract (skill-paradigms.md): any living owned larva anywhere on the battlefield is a valid host and there is no maximum transfer range, including a still-living dying larva; dead larvae and dormant spore beds are not hosts. Every living larva touches the same network of flora roots and fungal mycelium, a biological neural pathway, so cover, local line of sight and height impose no range gate. Larva hit points are 15% of her maximum health (240 of 1600). Modelled as the carrier of this passive, with capacity as the entity count (3, 4, 5). No manifest model fits a larva. forms.name: the soil has nerves
forms.description: Maintain four larvae. Each senses movement within 3 m (300 cm) and sends a local pulse through the root network, showing a brief positional disturbance rather than an enemy identity through walls. Her brood becomes a distributed warning system and a set of possible bodies, not just teleport markers. Natural expiry still removes an old host.

forms.name: a nursery remembers
forms.description: Maintain five larvae. A larva killed by damage leaves a dormant root bed for 6 s (180 ticks). Feeding it a primary and one Brood pip within 6 m (600 cm) grows a fresh normal larva, subject to capacity. A dormant bed is not alive and cannot receive her consciousness. Killing hosts still denies immediate escape; she must physically revisit and cultivate their remains.

basic.name: gel spur / feeding time
basic.description: Snap a ceramic-tipped gel spur for 80 damage within 6 m (600 cm). Aim it at an owned living larva instead to feed 80 healing, spending the attack. Ground-holding lays a larva under Blackwater Nursery. Her primary therefore chooses between pressure, sustaining a distant-return investment and expanding the nursery.

active.name: blackwater transfer
active.description: Select any living larva at any range, melt into the departure pond and dying larva, then rebuild at the destination under the full distance-based contract. Both endpoints expose the transformation through jade root pulses. Recovery is 8 s (240 ticks) after completed emergence. A global retreat means committing to a long, targetable reassembly, not instantly returning to combat.

signature.name: abyssal metamorph: nursery titan
signature.description: Reconfigure over 0.8 s (24 ticks) into her continuous colossal gel-metal serpent for 10 s (300 ticks), with up to 12 m (1200 cm) of local articulated body. Her upper torso remains its conscious head. The body intercepts projectiles using her own health, with one damage instance per enemy cast. Choose up to two points along her traveled route to drop larvae, spending existing Brood pips and obeying capacity. She lays refuges as she winds through the fight. Cooldown: 28 s (840 ticks) after the form ends.

passive.stock: Start with two Brood pips. Moving 12 m (1200 cm) along the ground earns one pip, at most once every 6 s (180 ticks), reserve two. Hold a ground-targeted primary for 0.4 s (12 ticks) to spend one and lay a huge rooted gel larva at her feet. Maintain three larvae, each roughly 2.5 m (250 cm) long, with 15% of her maximum health and a 30 s (900 ticks) life. At capacity, deliberately select one to retire before laying another. They intercept hostile shots; bodies can be waded through slowly. Allies move through freely.

counterplay: Destroy or age out larvae and patrol marked hotspots; a dead larva cannot be selected and a dormant root bed is not a host.

forms.name: blackwater nursery
forms.description: Start with two Brood pips. Moving 12 m (1200 cm) along the ground earns one pip, at most once every 6 s (180 ticks), reserve two. forms.name: the soil has nerves
forms.description: Maintain four larvae. Each senses movement within 3 m (300 cm) and sends a local pulse through the root network, showing a brief positional disturbance rather than an enemy identity through walls. Her brood becomes a distributed warning system and a set of possible bodies, not just teleport markers. Natural expiry still removes an old host.

forms.name: a nursery remembers
forms.description: Maintain five larvae. A larva killed by damage leaves a dormant root bed for 6 s (180 ticks). Feeding it a primary and one Brood pip within 6 m (600 cm) grows a fresh normal larva, subject to capacity. A dormant bed is not alive and cannot receive her consciousness. Killing hosts still denies immediate escape; she must physically revisit and cultivate their remains.

basic.stock: Snap a ceramic-tipped gel spur for 80 damage within 6 m (600 cm). Aim it at an owned living larva instead to feed 80 healing, spending the attack. Ground-holding lays a larva under Blackwater Nursery. Her primary therefore chooses between pressure, sustaining a distant-return investment and expanding the nursery.
basic.interpretation: Numbers are the prototype values of the 2026-11-07 proposal; rank descriptions specify behavior. Geometry is the authored illustration profile, not an executable collision bake.
counterplay: Break the line to the larvae; a larva loaded with a stored spur is a visible, killable defender.

forms.name: gel spur / feeding time
forms.description: Snap a ceramic-tipped gel spur for 80 damage within 6 m (600 cm). Aim it at an owned living larva instead to feed 80 healing, spending the attack. Ground-holding lays a larva under Blackwater Nursery. Her primary therefore chooses between pressure, sustaining a distant-return investment and expanding the nursery.

forms.name: feed through
forms.description: A spur can pass through one owned larva, feeding it 40 healing, then continue toward an enemy for its original 80 damage, within the same 6 m (600 cm) total path. It still collides with solid terrain and the first enemy. A direct full feeding remains 80 healing. Her position relative to a huge grub creates the useful firing angle.

forms.name: loaded appetite
forms.description: Instead of healing, load a living larva within 6 m (600 cm) with one stored 80-damage spur for 6 s (180 ticks). It gives a 0.5 s (15 ticks) tell before snapping at the next enemy within 3 m (300 cm), then spends the charge. Each larva stores one; the attack cannot load another larva. She sacrifices a current shot to make a future refuge defend itself.

active.stock: Select any living larva at any range, melt into the departure pond and dying larva, then rebuild at the destination under the full distance-based contract. forms.name: blackwater transfer
forms.description: Select any living larva at any range, melt into the departure pond and dying larva, then rebuild at the destination under the full distance-based contract. forms.name: change the thought mid-sentence
forms.description: During reassembly, reroute once to any other living larva. The occupied unfinished body melts into another dying larva. forms.name: keep the abandoned self

Either larva remains a valid transfer target at any distance; occupying it collapses the screen. Her fortress is grown from vulnerable future bodies.

forms.name: the nursery is everywhere
forms.description: Queue the signature during a transfer to emerge as the serpent for 12 s (360 ticks) after rebuilding finishes. Alternatively, start a remote signature on any living larva using Blackwater Transfer's readiness and full melt/rebuilding procedure; this consumes both recoveries. While colossal, her one primary attack may originate from any living larva anywhere, striking one enemy within 3 m (300 cm) of that larva for 80. The larva provides only its local sensed view; this creates no omniscient targeting or extra simultaneous attacks. A distant brood becomes her distributed reach while her real body stays singular.

iconFamily.subject: a bold serpent coil dripping a single chunky drop of gel
iconFamily.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one base raster concept for a game ability icon, to be traced into SVG. Character: Ophidia. Theme: blackwater coil. Subject: a bold serpent coil dripping a single chunky drop of gel. Centered compact square silhouette, fills 82% of canvas. Flat solid black monochromatic ink on genuinely transparent background. Exceptionally bold clean outer contour, broad shapes and large negative-space gaps. Recognizable at 24 to 30 pixels. No tiny details, thin lines, text, badges, borders, HUD elements, colored accents, gradients, shadows, textures or 3D. ONE original base emblem, not a sheet or variants. All four subsequent ability variations must keep this same identifiable theme.
iconFamily.method: built-in image generation, then silhouette tracing, then four SVG variations
